cause: The fixture cleared inherited environment fields with undefined values. HostProcess spreads options.env after its data-directory assignment, so PI_DESKTOP_DATA_DIR was removed. Rust uses the Windows known-folder profile, independently of HOME and USERPROFILE.
confirmedEffects: The temporary Host opened the current user's default profile and completed handshake.
A read-only metadata query confirmed its execution owner: PID 17064, creation FILETIME 134387234329112520, retired=0, image ending in h1-rust-inspection-host.exe.
The temporary Host exited; the failed fixture report confirmed cleanup. No test session, native runner, tool or provider was started before the failure.
unknownEffects: Normal startup migration, recovery and sweeps may have modified user data. No pre-run baseline exists; exact data changes and absence of impact cannot be established.
preservation: No default-profile file, backup or journal row was removed, reset, repaired or rolled back. Investigation queried schema and specific test-owner metadata, not session content.
disclosure: The user was informed of confirmed unintended startup and unknown effects.
correction: Every fixture Host explicitly supplies PI_DESKTOP_DATA_DIR in its final environment override and checks the expected scratch database after handshake.
qualificationLimit: A corrected isolated run does not erase the deviation or establish default-profile integrity. Scratch logs and the original incident note remain retained.
